title: Gems of China | Discover Shanghai and Xian
highlights: Experience the perfect blend of ancient time and modern energy in Shanghai and Xi’an—where rich history, vibrant culture, and dynamic cityscapes await!
Cruise the Huangpu River and enjoy a view of Shanghai’s skyline, where modern towers and historic landmarks come together for a unique city experience.
Visit Shanghai Disneyland, home to the first-ever TRON Lightcycle ride and the towering Enchanted Storybook Castle, offering a one-of-a-kind Disney experience in Asia.
Hop on the Maglev Train and feel the excitement as you soar at lightning-fast speeds, making your way between Shanghai and the airport in no time.
Marvel at the Terra Cotta Warriors in Xi’an, an archaeological wonder where thousands of statues stand frozen in time, guarding the first emperor’s tomb.
inclusions: Transfer from Shanghai Pudong International Airport to Deluxe Hotel
4 nights stay in Shanghai with breakfast
Shanghai Southern Great Wall Day Trip
2 nights stay in Xi An with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Xi'an Xianyang International Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: Travelers need a Chinese visa, so apply in advance to avoid delays.
The official currency is the Chinese Yuan (CNY); exchange some cash for small purchases.
Wear comfortable shoes, as some sections including the Great Wall of China have steep steps and uneven paths.
English is limited; downloading a translation app can be helpful.
Many sites like Google and WhatsApp are restricted, so install a VPN beforehand.
Modest clothing is recommended when visiting places like the Jade Buddha Temple.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Shanghai | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Shanghai! Upon arrival at Shanghai Pudong International Airport, get transferred to your hotel. Check in and spend your time at leisure. You can admire the historic and modern blend of architecture along the Bund. Or, visit the Shanghai Museum to explore centuries of Chinese heritage. You can also indulge in shopping at the lively Nanjing Road, before returning to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Half-Day Shanghai City Tour | Visit to Oriental Pearl Tower | Hungpu River Cruise Experience
days.desc: Today, get driven to uncover Shanghai’s timeless treasures, starting with the Jade Buddha Temple, a sacred site housing jade statues. Next, wander through the beautiful Yu Garden, filled with pavilions and ponds. Visit the revered Longhua Temple, home to a striking 10th-century pagoda. Later, soak in Shanghai’s dazzling skyline from the Oriental Pearl Tower. Then, enjoy a scenic Huangpu River cruise, witnessing the city’s glowing waterfront by night. Afterward, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Visit Disneyland | Meet your favorite Disney Characters
days.desc: Today, get transferred to experience the wonder of Shanghai Disneyland. Start with the high-speed thrill of TRON Lightcycle Power Run, then explore the breathtaking Enchanted Storybook Castle, the tallest in Disney history. Wander through themed lands packed with immersive rides, beloved characters, and performances. Conclude your day with the dazzling Ignite the Dream fireworks show before getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Southern Great Wall Day Trip
days.desc: In the morning, set off on a journey to Linhai with a scenic bullet train ride from Shanghai. Upon arrival, explore the Jiangnan Great Wall, where centuries-old stone pathways lead to stunning panoramas. Next, wander through Ziyang Old Street, a cultural gem filled with historic buildings, street vendors, and handcrafted goods. Savor authentic local flavors before catching your train back to Shanghai. Upon arrival, head back to your hotel for an overnight stay.

days.title: Exclusive Maglev Train Ride | Fly to Xian | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Post check-out, make your way to Longyang Road Station and experience the thrill of the Maglev Train, the world’s fastest commercial train, as it takes you to the airport. Next, board your flight to Xi’an, China’s ancient capital. Upon arrival, head to your hotel. Check in and spend your free time exploring the lively Muslim Quarter, filled with traditional crafts and street food, or visit the Shaanxi History Museum, home to artifacts that tells Xi’an’s rich past.

days.title: Xian Sightseeing Tour
days.desc: Today, get driven to dive into Xi’an’s rich history on a sightseeing tour. Begin at the Museum of Qin Terra Cotta Warriors and Horses, where over 8,000 life-sized warriors stand as guardians of China’s first emperor. Next, stroll across the Ancient City Wall, offering panoramic views of the historic city, before admiring the Xi’an Bell Tower, a landmark of the city’s past. End at the Giant Wild Goose Pagoda, a UNESCO-listed treasure from the Tang Dynasty. Afterward, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Departure Day
days.desc: In the morning, check out from your hotel and get transferred to the airport for your flight back home. This marks the end of your China trip.
